messages:
Jaime: Heads up everyone 0123 — Hail just started between Church and Castro, N-Judah stopped for a bit. If youre on surface transit, expect a slow crawl. Stay safe! :cloud_with_snow:
Nina: On the N. Sheltered by a bakery. Theyre handing out free mini donuts to waiting passengers? San Francisco, youre wild. :doughnut: :joy:
Carlos: Pics or it didnt happen. Also my commute scooter is now a personal hail catcher. RIP tires. :crying_cat_face:
Mei: Anyone want a poncho? I keep extras in my bag. Ill leave one by the office concierge. React :poncho: if youd wear one, :thumbsup: if youd donate one.
Riley: :poncho: *and* :doughnut: voting yes to both. Also the office dog 'Nimbus' is judging from the window. He looks offended.
OpsBot: SF Muni alert: https://status.sfmta.com/incident/6021 
``n_judah: delayed due to weather (hail) | est: 10-30 mins
caltrain: normal

Jaime: Thanks @OpsBot. If it keeps up we might need a temporary shuttle plan. Carlos, want to try walking 7 blocks to Market? Might be faster than waiting for N to unfreeze.
Carlos: Might. Donut bribery is persuasive. Mei, Ill take a poncho if you dont mind.
Mei: Leaving one with concierge labeled "for Carlos". Also leaving a spare in the small locker for anyone else.
Nina: Quick micro-poll: should we add a "rain/hail supplies" shelf to the breakroom? Towels, ponchos, hand warmers. :memo: React :+1: for yes, :-1: for no.
Jaime: :+1: absolutely.
Riley: :+1: and also a tiny plaque for the donut hero.
Carlos: Arrived at Market. Donut confirmed. Mobility = restored. Thanks everyone.
Mei: Update: concierge says theyve had three poncho drop-offs already. This team is peak neighborly. :sparkles:
Jaime: OK commute war-room adjourned. If youre out, post quick status so we know who made it in. Stay warm and dry yall. :coffee:
